name: Yamiyo ni Odore -Witch Wishes to Commit the Night-
original_name: 闇夜に踊れ -Witch wishes to commit the Night-
source:
Witches and magicians have always been fighting each other since the beginning of time. It’s not because one is bad or good, but because their powers keeps the world in balance. So, in a time continuum separated from the world, they continue their long battle. Note that you can choose to be a male or female protagonist.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
從時間的開端起，魔女與魔法師就一直彼此爭鬥。這並非因為一方邪惡、另一方正義，而是因為雙方的力量維繫著世界平衡。於是，他們在一條與世界分離的時空連續體中延續著漫長的戰爭。玩家可以選擇男性或女性主角。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
